{{Top}}
'''Emergency Amendment 121b''', or as it was more commonly known, the '''Reflex Amendment''' was an act passed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] at [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] bidding in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. In Palpatine's words, the Amendment provided for "efficient streamlining of cumbersome bureaucracy." In other terms, it allowed the Chancellor to react to any battles without consulting the Congress. It also allowed the Chancellor to interfere in the local government of [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and [[Planet/Legends|planets]].
